stem.text: Three identical springs, each with the same spring constant, are connected together in four different arrangements, as shown.
Which arrangement has the largest combined spring constant?

A.alt: Two bars joined by two branches: the left branch has two springs one above the other, the right branch has one spring.

B.alt: Two bars joined by three springs side by side.

C.alt: Two springs side by side between a top bar and a middle bar, with one spring below the middle bar, joined to a bottom bar.

D.alt: Three springs in a single vertical line between a top bar and a bottom bar.
